label: SIMULATED TRAINING EXPERIMENT — NOT HUMAN EFFICACY EVIDENCE

pre_specified_metrics: fraction reaching minimum hidden skill 0.7 within 30 sessions
median threshold session among those reaching (censored others)
config.limitations: Abstract selection model, uncalibrated focused learning law, equal four-task assessment per session; not a human training or tactical-simulation efficacy experiment. Report both arms even if adaptive is negative.

method: Paired seeds, identical initial hidden probabilities, assessment uniforms and focused learning law. Production Thompson selector/template adapter/Red Force versus uniform random focus/template; identical Beta-based difficulty rule. One abstract Bernoulli assessment per canonical skill/session. Hidden competence is separate from Beta estimates. No tactical physics, human learners or empirical learning-rate calibration.
